providerContinuityTable.providerStrengthsEvidence: Anakin Skywalker (Hayden Christensen likeness) maintains identical bone structure, jawline, and modern undercut pompadour hairstyle across desert (00:01), studio (00:13), council room (00:58), and bridge shots (01:32).
providerContinuityTable.providerDefectsLimitations: Micro-flicker in hair edge boundary against the solid red cyc (00:25); slight smoothing of skin texture in extreme close-ups compared to wider shots.

providerContinuityTable.providerStrengthsEvidence: Padmé script above right eyebrow and "i hate sand" script on the left neck maintain identical font, scale, and placement from 00:08 through 00:28 and 01:53.
providerContinuityTable.providerDefectsLimitations: Subtle letter-weight variation on the "SITH LORD" sub-eye tattoo between the extreme close-up at 00:30 and the wider council shot at 01:47.

providerContinuityTable.providerStrengthsEvidence: Grillz on lower teeth clearly visible and stable at 00:08; lip-sync phoneme shapes match lead vocal syllables well in studio mic setups (00:13–00:15).
providerContinuityTable.providerDefectsLimitations: At 00:36–00:38 and 01:13, lip movement exhibits slight rubbery dampening ("floating mouth" phenomenon common in neural face reenactment), where jaw movement lags audio transients.

providerContinuityTable.providerRating: High conceptual separation, intentional costume changes
providerContinuityTable.providerStrengthsEvidence: Armor plates, chest control box, and cape in 00:46 and 01:31 accurately mirror Darth Vader’s iconic suit while leaving head exposed. Casual black t-shirt and heavy chain appear consistently in solo performance shots.
providerContinuityTable.providerDefectsLimitations: The cape attachment mechanism in 00:54 floats slightly over the collarbone without visible clasps or structural seams connecting it to the under-tunic.

providerContinuityTable.providerStrengthsEvidence: Hand gestures during vocal delivery are mostly hidden or kept low. Leather gauntlets holding Yoda’s neck at 01:17 have correct five-finger geometry and firm grip contact.
providerContinuityTable.providerDefectsLimitations: Hand holding the severed Tusken Raider head at 01:27 is occluded beneath the lower frame edge, avoiding complex multi-finger contact rendering.

providerContinuityTable.providerStrengthsEvidence: Directional sunset rim light in the council room (00:58, 01:47) precisely matches the sun position visible outside the window plates.
providerContinuityTable.providerDefectsLimitations: Mace Windu falling in the white void (00:17, 01:08) displays pre-keyed edge halos along the brown robe edges where original background spill was clipped.
